text:
maria zhang: CustY sent back their security questionnaire. They want: signed key-rotation proof, BYOK option, SIEM export, and IR timelines for Private. Need a short answer pack.

jamal singh: do they want escrow or only evidence of rotation?

maria zhang: both options; BYOK preferred, plus our attestation artifact.

alex harris: we can emit a signed rotation manifest (append-only) with old/new key ids, rotated_by, timestamp, and sha256 signature. Recommend a per-tenant rotation service account so the principal is explicit.

natalie chen: agree on per-tenant SA. @jamal can you confirm Dedicated vs Private behavior?

jamal singh: Dedicated: tenant-scoped SAs exist. Private: if customer supplies KMS we don't create keys in their HSM; but we can still produce our signed manifest. HSM vendor attestation is vendor-dependent.

rohit patel: note for the questionnaire: 1) HSM attestation requires vendor cooperation; 2) SIEM exports we support JSONL to S3, webhook, Syslog, Splunk forwarder (need endpoint + retention).

alex harris: sample manifest to paste in answers:

{"tenant_id":"custy-7","event":"kms_key_rotation","old_key":"k-7a","new_key":"k-9f","rotated_by":"sa:kms-rotator:custy-7","time":"2026-06-01T12:02:03Z","manifest_sig":"sha256:aa11bb...","hsm_attestation":"on-request"}

natalie chen: IR SLA we can commit to for Private: acknowledge 15m, triage 1h, containment plan 4h, forensic collection started 24h (coordination may extend for customer-managed HSM).

maria zhang: can we also give a short checklist for their tracker?

jamal singh: checklist items: BYOK support + docs, per-tenant rotation SA, signed manifests retained 1y, audit logs retention default 90d (configurable), supported export endpoints, IR SLAs, HSM attestation note.

rohit patel: vuln-triage: if rotation due to compromise we rotate dependent secrets and invalidate KV caches referencing old keys. Add to runbook.

alex harris: log sample auditors like:
Jun 01 12:02:03 redwood-kms[rotator]: tenant=custy-7 event=kms_key_rotation new_key=k-9f rotated_by=sa:kms-rotator:custy-7 manifest_sig=sha256:aa11bb...
Jun 01 12:02:04 redwood-audit: tenant=custy-7 event=grant subject=sa:ingest request_id=req-abc

maria zhang: Deploy-bot, attach IR runbook link please.

deploy-bot: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ir-private-deployments|IR runbook (private)> :paperclip:

natalie chen: once Jamal posts the checklist and a one-paragraph RBAC note I'll assemble the response and loop in Legal for HSM wording.

maria zhang: Jamal, checklist + RBAC blurb by EOD?

jamal singh: yes, posting by 18:00 PT. Flag: managed Splunk connector may be a small project if they want on-prem push.

maria zhang: thanks team, will send draft to CustY sec after checklist.
